To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the circadian cycles of the cardiovascular system are characterized by a complex structure and that the circadian rhythm of the cardiovascular function is an important factor of its regulation and can be used for the detection of disorders of the time organization of the cardiovascular function and as a basis for chronotherapy of cardiovascular disorders.

circadian rhythms of the cardiovascular system are characterized by the presence of the following features: (1) the presence of a rhythm with a period of 24 h in all the studied functions of the cardiovascular system; (2) the presence of the second rhythm with a period close to the first one in some functions (heart rate, arterial blood pressure, cardiac output, and blood volume); (3) the presence of rhythms with a period of more than 24 h in the studied functions of blood pressure

the chronodiagnosis of the circadian rhythms of the cardiovascular system can be performed in patients with various forms of arterial hypertension, coronary heart disease, and heart failure, as well as in patients with acute myocardial infarction.
